detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Build an unstoppable army in this fantasy strategy roguelite auto-battler. Recruit Bannerlings, place them in formation, fuse them into stronger and specialized versions, and stack emblems to further upgrade them.

Build your army, then watch it fight

Battles play out automatically, but the setup is yours. Position your squad, choose your composition and build the ultimate army.

Fuse units into stronger forms

Combine matching Bannerlings to evolve them. Unlock subclasses and ascensions that change how a unit fights, then build around their strengths.

Customize with emblems

Emblems enhance your units with new stats, abilities, and synergies. Chase broken combos, or pivot when the run offers something unexpected.

Adapt to every encounter

The road never plays fair. Face shifting enemy armies, unpredictable events, and tempting shops that force hard choices between greed, power, and survival.

Every run demands a new plan

Randomized encounters, shop offers, and rewards keep every run unpredictable. Learn the systems, then invent the army that wins this run.

Raise your banners

Every run earns Banner Points, win or lose. Level up four war banners, each with its own twist on the rules, and unlock perks that shape how your next run begins.

Features

  • 15 unit types with 30 subclasses and 60 ascensions, creating 100+ unique unit variants

  • 100+ emblems to specialize your units with

  • 40 battle encounters with 4 main bosses

  • 10+ unique events

  • 3 difficulties, plus a Ranked Challenge leaderboard

  • 4 war banners and 15 perks to unlock
